summary: Today’s tape is mixed to mildly risk-on: crypto commentary leans selective, with several analysts still preferring altcoin setups over BTC/ETH, while macro sources keep highlighting USD, gold, and crude as event-driven and vulnerable to policy headlines. In the materials provided, the clearest new crypto themes are continued interest in high-beta alts and a cautious, range-bound stance on major benchmarks like Bitcoin and Ethereum.[2][3]
